reviews.rationale: Test mode returns three predetermined relic rewards rather than the native rarity-pool draws. The v10 wrapper has no restoration for this method; seeded reward and RNG-counter differentials are required.

Test mode uses preset potion models instead of the normal generated potion rewards. The v10 wrapper has no restoration for this method; generated offers, capacity choices and RNG consumption need comparison.

The normal undiscovered alternative-act preference is skipped in test mode. A fully unlocked content policy does not specify discovered acts. Freeze the progress/discovery contract and compare initial act choices and RNG advancement.

Test mode takes the first bundle without a player choice. The current nine native selection observation boundaries do not include this bundle method. Preserve advertised bundle choice and selection synchronization before qualifying it.

Native selector-stack cleanup is conditional on test mode being off. Interrupted selections and repeated resets need a bound clean-state test; wrapper scope disposal alone is not proof that all native stacks reset.

Test mode uses a test selector or selects rewards automatically. The v10 wrapper installs its reward selector in both start and load paths. This is a declared control seam that needs multi-reward, capacity and cancellation coverage rather than assuming the branch harmless.

Test mode applies damage to the enemy list directly; the normal path schedules damage per visual-hit callback. Death and on-damage ordering need a differential with multiple enemies; batching cannot be declared presentation-only.

A non-null test generator replaces native rest-option generation. Assert it remains unset in production collection and across resets. Existing finite rest fixtures do not establish all hook/option coverage.
The test branch skips recording unpurchased offers in map-point history; inspected remainder records choice history. This review does not certify full history/save parity or all shop effects.

Test mode allows a fallback mock RNG when no run is attached. Ensure gameplay models use the active run and player RNGs; model-preview use is separate from seeded gameplay. No fallback reachability claim follows static reading.

Original test-mode branch skips price RNG. The current v9/v10 wrapper restores this exact branch and the eight-case v2 shop panel verifies scoped price/effect agreement. This is a known scoped mitigation, not a new unfixed price regression.
The reviewed method returns no reward icon in test mode; reward selection and effects belong to separate methods.
The reviewed method skips the potion icon node in test mode; procurement and reward choice are not qualified by that observation.
The reviewed test-mode path returns no event asset paths. Actual event choice effects remain outside this method review.
